CombatLogout compatibility prerelease for Minecraft 26.3 and Java 25. The existing project version remains `1.0-SNAPSHOT`; the plugin descriptor reports `1.0`.

Built against Paper API 26.3.build.200-stable. Download `combatlogout-1.0-SNAPSHOT.jar` and place it in the Paper 26.3 server's `plugins` folder. The server requires Java 25. `SHA256SUMS` contains the checksum of this exact release build.

The release workflow performs a clean Gradle build before uploading the JAR. This repository has no automated test sources; live server and multiplayer gameplay were not tested.
